brief: No new setups: 5 of 5 slots are open (AAVE, kPEPE, UNI, XMR, LINK), all triggered. The board is a broad 1d breakdown (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP) with long liquidation flow; ten tripwires hit, nine of them range_breakout or reclaim ideas that cannot be written up while the slots are full. Watchlist is led by BTC and ETH washouts, which we lean toward a bounce if OI flushes further. HYPE funding is back at 32.23, above the 30 cap, the L2 funding-premise risk to watch. The hl-cycles feed is stale (17.4 h), a data gap.
